name: Screen-Print Duotone
description: The subject reduced to a true two-ink duotone screen-print, with bold halftone dot patterns standing in for tonal gradation and a deliberate registration offset at the edges. Flat, frontal, and printed on coarse poster paper rather than photographed, with unmistakable ink-to-paper contrast that reads as a genuine print, not a filtered photo.
lighting: Flat frontal screened flash, halftone-only shading
subject: either
prompt: A heavyweight cream and kraft-toned hoodie screen-printed with a bold graphic wordmark in exactly two inks — deep ink-black and saturated safety-orange — rendered as a true two-ink screen-print poster, shown front-on with the full print visible in a flat, frontal, poster-like composition, reduced to bold, sharply defined halftone dot patterns standing in for all tonal gradation, a deliberate two-ink registration offset visible along the print's high-contrast edges, coarse poster-paper grain texture across the surface, flat frontal screened-flash lighting with no dimensional shading beyond what the halftone dots imply, no props in frame beyond the garment itself, genuine halftone dot geometry and authentic two-ink flatness rather than a blur filter or photographic gradient.
